messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
But I am at work today miserable and exhausted trying to keep my eyes focused and my head up.

output.original_text: But I am at work today miserable and exhausted trying to keep my eyes focused and my head up.
output.joy: But I am at work today, buzzing with excitement and energy, eager to keep my eyes focused and my head up!
output.sadness: But I am at work today, feeling so miserable and exhausted, struggling to keep my eyes focused and my head up.
output.fear: But I am at work today, feeling miserable and exhausted, desperately trying to keep my eyes focused and my head up at the thought of failing.
output.anger: But I am at work today, utterly miserable and exhausted, fighting to keep my eyes focused and my head up despite everything!
output.surprise: But I am at work today, surprisingly miserable and exhausted, fighting to keep my eyes focused and my head up!
output.disgust: But I am at work today, feeling utterly miserable and exhausted, struggling to keep my eyes focused and my head up in this unpleasant situation.
